reigns.note: The Delphic land, the Pataraean realm, Claros and Tenedos revere his name — Patara on the Lycian coast held his coastal oracle, where the Lycians kept a bronze bowl in the temple of Apollo.
The Lycians at Patara displayed a bronze bowl in Apollo's temple, saying Telephus dedicated it and Hephaestus made it — a Mysian king's offering at the Lycian oracle, not a local dynasty.
